proof_body:
by
  intro f c r R M z w hrR hf hb hz hw
  have hρ : 0 < (R - r) / 2 := by linarith
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, Metric.closedBall x ((R - r) / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball c R := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have h1 := mem_closedBall_iff_norm.mp hx
    have h2 := mem_closedBall_iff_norm.mp hy
    rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
    have h3 : ‖y - c‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x - c‖ := by
      have := norm_add_le (y - x) (x - c)
      simpa using this
    linarith
  have hball : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, x ∈ Metric.ball c R := fun x hx => hsub x hx (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le)
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, ‖deriv f x‖ ≤ 2 * M / (R - r) := by
    intro x hx
    have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball x ((R - r) / 2)) := by
      apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
      rw [closure_ball x hρ.ne']
      exact hf.mono (hsub x hx)
    have := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hρ hdc (C := M) (fun y hy => hb y (hsub x hx (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hy)))
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    have hne : R - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, DifferentiableAt ℂ f x := fun x hx => hf.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hball x hx))
  exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hdiff hderiv (convex_closedBall c r) hw hz
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r R M : ℝ) (z w : ℂ), r < R → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ‖f x‖ ≤ M) → z ∈ Metric.closedBall c r → w ∈ Metric.closedBall c r → ‖f z - f w‖ ≤ 2 * M / (R - r) * ‖z - w‖
